decisions.reason: The firm raised its visible commitment by giving the condenser its own page in 2024, and the product sits close to its core air-cooled line, so dropping it would expose a fresh, public investment as a mistake.
Like B, it was promoted to a dedicated page in 2024, which signals growing public commitment to a core product line, and any weak early results can still be attributed to ramp-up.

The tube liner fits the firm's announced lifecycle-service strategy and builds on established repair know-how, so the low cost of keeping it and its strategic fit favor persistence despite only modest promotion.

Customized air coolers are central to the firm's claim of integrated tailored solutions, so withdrawing it would contradict its stated direction, although it has received only modest visible investment.
Tube end repair inserts support the service and spare-parts business the firm emphasizes, and they cost little to keep, so there is little reason to write them off.
